name: Christian Fellowship
overview: Christian fellowship is portrayed in Scripture as a vital and joyful unity among believers, where brethren dwell together in harmony and mutual love, as emphasized in Psalms 133:1 and Romans 12:10. It is marked by steadfast commitment to the apostles' teaching, communal practices such as breaking of bread and prayer (Acts 2:42), and mutual encouragement to love and good works (Hebrews 10:24). Christ's presence is assured when believers gather in His name, highlighting the spiritual reality of their union (Matthew 18:20). The appointment of elders and prayerful dedication within the church community (Acts 14:23) further underscores the ordered and prayerful nature of true Christian fellowship.
